limitations: Targeted sample, not a full Wikidata crosswalk.
Wikidata coordinates are claims, not a survey oracle; a 25km review flag is heuristic and does not authorize replacement.
Map-unit label points are not entity centroids; point distance alone does not establish identity mismatch.
Best-rank population statements retain dates/qualifier property IDs; definitions and current capital/country roles need editorial review.
UN webpage snapshot is a research reference; no redistribution permission for its full table is asserted.

m49.join_policy: Natural Earth ISO_A3_EH when a valid three-letter code, else ISO_A3; sentinel codes are never guessed from names.
m49.scope: Reference-only ISO code comparison, not a sovereignty/recognition decision; no M49 table or region labels emitted into editions.

m49_country_map_unit_union.warning: Coverage of a code is not a one-to-one identity join. Layers and aggregates remain source-scoped.

m49_map_units.join_policy: Natural Earth ISO_A3_EH when a valid three-letter code, else ISO_A3; sentinel codes are never guessed from names.
m49_map_units.scope: Reference-only ISO code comparison, not a sovereignty/recognition decision; no M49 table or region labels emitted into editions.
